name: Crew Chief
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Crew Chief turns lifecycle reports from Claude Code, Codex, Herdr, and any tool that can run a command into an attention-first Omarchy console. The bar stays quiet without a fleet, counts work and turns urgent when a session needs you. Open the panel to see project, harness, state, age, and the prompt headline, with blocked work first; jump to its terminal or dismiss it. A private bounded local spool carries lifecycle metadata only. No network, account, API key, telemetry, or transcript polling.

barWidget.description: The pill disappears when no agent is reporting, shows the fleet count while work runs and escalates to NEEDS YOU the moment work blocks. The keyboard-ready panel sorts attention first and shows project, harness, state, age, and a capped message. Click a row to focus its terminal, right-click to dismiss it, or clear finished runs. Claude hooks, Codex notify, zero-config Herdr sync, and a generic reporter feed one private descriptor-bound spool with strict file, record, retention, and scan limits.

schema.label: Sync sessions from Herdr (when installed)
schema.description: When Herdr is installed, every agent pane it detects joins the fleet automatically, no hooks needed. Harmless no-op without Herdr.
